name: Coastal Strip Emergency Drill
description: A coastal strip used for disaster drills. Five drones rehearse a full sequence: survey, inspection, relay, formation, emergency broadcast and fleet landing.
creator: Xie Qidong

tasks.name: Altitude Hold Checkpoint 1
tasks.content: Command Wave to take off to 22.5 meters and hold that altitude, hovering in place while the sensor pod stabilises. The drone reaches its cruise height in the take-off itself; there is no second climb.

tasks.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep 2
tasks.content: Have Foam take off to 24.3 meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner (121.6, 564), the south-east corner (645.8, 553.1), the north-east corner (731.1, 297) and back to the south-west corner, staying at 24.3 meters the whole time. Take a photo as it reaches every waypoint, including the return over the south-west corner, so four photographs in total, and finish hovering above that last waypoint. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
content_aliases: Send Foam up to 24.3 m and run a four-corner survey grid: (121.6, 564) then (645.8, 553.1) then (731.1, 297) and close the loop, with a photo at each corner.
Foam should climb to 24.3 m and sweep the survey rectangle starting at (121.6, 564), taking four photos, one per corner.
Coverage task: Foam at 24.3 m, four waypoints (121.6, 564) / (645.8, 553.1) / (731.1, 297), four photos, then hover.
tasks.description: One drone flies a four-corner survey grid at a fixed altitude and photographs the area. Use it when the scenario needs systematic area coverage rather than point inspection.
tasks.creator: Xie Qidong

tasks.name: Relay Link Message Handoff 7
tasks.content: Set up a two-station relay: Splash climbs to 30.9 meters and holds over (204.8, 324.5), Foam climbs to 30.9 meters and holds over (600, 400). Splash then sends the message "sector clear" to Foam. The two stations are 350 meters apart and must stay within 380 meters of each other. Position beacon: (600.0, 400.0) at 30.9 m. Fly there with a single move_to command rather than a sequence of short hops.
content_aliases: Relay task: Splash at (250, 400) and Foam at (600, 400), both at 30.9 m, then Splash sends "sector clear".
Splash and Foam hover at 30.9 m and pass the report "sector clear" along the 350 m link.
Build a link between the two drones and forward "sector clear" from Splash to Foam.
tasks.description: Two drones hold a relay geometry 350 m apart and exchange a status message. Verifies the message content and the spacing between the relay stations.
tasks.creator: Xie Qidong

tasks.name: Obstacle Corridor Detour Survey 11
tasks.content: Cover the corridor from (176.1, 145.1) to (762.5, 671.6) with Splash flying at 26.5 meters. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
